name: Smart Breadcrumbs for Elementor
author: Themepoints

sections.description:
Smart Breadcrumbs for Elementor is an easy-to-use addon that adds SEO-friendly breadcrumb navigation to your Elementor pages.

Features include:
* Home link toggle
* Custom separator
* Alignment controls
* WooCommerce compatible
* Show/hide current page
* Fully Elementor style controls
* Schema markup ready
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘smart-breadcrumbs-for-elementor’ to ‘/wp-content/plugins/’.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress plugins menu.
  3. Open Elementor and search for “Smart Breadcrumbs”.
  4. Drag & drop into your layout.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor Free?

Yes, fully compatible.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. Category, product, and archive breadcrumbs are supported.
